headline: v1.1 Ackermann is done and tagged (49/57, 0 unsafe, 2D gets 36/57). v2 (heading planner + tip margin + crest fix) matches v1.1 everywhere and solves lane25. It keeps the tip margin: without it slopes drops to 25/30 with 7 tip-monitor stops. Bars stays the weak world. Swerve stays experimental.

queue.label: v2 with margin 0.05 on rock_field and urc_mix, second sample
v2 on crater_field and marsyard, second sample
Swerve without the controller's terrain cost (Ackermann climbs without it): lane25, sidehill, crater far_left plus regression

plans: Now: margin 0 repeat on slopes and bars (ackf0r), margin 0.05 repeats on bars and slopes (ackfr3) and rock_field and urc_mix (ackfr4)
v2 cut after the last repeats (ackfr3, ackfr4): Phase 5 gate on the v2 runs, paper and deck updated, tag for Ram to push
Then: roll estimate for short steps (bars), swerve controller slope cost, recoveries
summary: Phases 0 to 3 gates met. Phase 3 closed 14 Nov on v1.1 (fine global map step + re-approach tree).
v1.1 against 2D: 86% vs 63% goals, 0 vs 1 unsafe, about 6x fewer recoveries, same median time. Biggest gains on slopes (13/15 vs 6/15) and bars.
v2 Ackermann: heading-aware Hybrid-A* planner (only holds headings the terrain allows), safe-heading mask now uses the tip monitor's 13.2 deg abort line, and a ramp-crest mapper stall fixed.

Swerve (Phase 4): best full run 36/57, always fails lane25, sidehill_uphill and crater far_left. The heading anchor stopped the spinning, now the controller hesitates at the ramp foot. Stays experimental.
Phase 5 code (governor, tip monitor, collision monitor) is on in every 3D run. Its gate is not formally recorded yet, planned on the v2 full run.
Real-rover tests from 22 Nov need rover data from Ram (see Needs you).

updates.text: v2 third run on slopes and bars: slopes 14/15 (lane25 now 8/9), bars 2/6. Over three runs each, the margin gives slopes 43/45 and bars 4/18, no margin gives slopes 25/30 and bars 10/18.

Margin 0 repeat: slopes 11/15, all four losses are tip-monitor stops at 13.3 deg. Decision: v2 keeps the tip margin (slopes 29/30 with it, 25/30 without). Bars needs a better roll estimate on short steps, next task after v2.

v2 with margin 0 over all 6 worlds: 51/57, the same as with the margin. Margin 0 wins bars (6/12 vs 2/12) and rock_field ahead_10m (3/3 vs 1/3), the margin wins lane25 (6/6 vs 4/6, two tip cancels at 13.4 deg without it). Repeats of both are running.

Swerve lane25 bag with the heading anchor: the spinning is gone. Now the controller dithers at the ramp foot (0.09 m/s, reversing 21% of the time) while the speed limit allows 0.37 m/s. Next swerve step is the controller's slope cost, after the v2 cut.

v2 with the tip margin off: bars 4/6 (2/12 with it), slopes 14/15 (one tip cancel by the monitor at 13.3 deg). The margin keeps roll lower but blocks the headings that cross bars. Margin 0 runs on the other worlds queued to pick the v2 config.

v1.1 + margin on rock_field, urc_mix, bars: 16/24 (v2 18/24 on the same worlds). v1.1 also stalls at the first bar on bars, so that failure is not the new planner. v2 is at least equal to v1.1 everywhere, with lane25 as the clear gain.
Swerve with the heading anchor: 1/9 on its failing goals (same as before), regression 4/6 (was 6/6, two tip cancels on urc_mix). No gain, not adopted. Swerve stays experimental.

v2 repeat: slopes 14/15 (lane25 3/3 again), bars 0/6. Over both runs v2 bars is 2/12 against v1.1 3/6. The rover stalls at the first bar or finds no safe heading near the goal. Testing the tip margin as the cause (ackf0), with a v1.1 + margin baseline (ckm6).

Swerve v7 on the crest-fix build: 1/9 on its three failing goals (was 0/9), regression 6/6. No change on lane25, still the spin-in-place pattern. The heading-anchor fix (sw7a) runs next against this as baseline.

v2 candidate on rock_field, urc_mix, bars: 18/24 (v1.1 18/24). Over 6 worlds 51/57 vs v1.1 49/57, 0 unsafe. One loss: bars past_bars_4m 0/3, with the tip margin the planner sees no safe heading near the goal (2/3 without it). v1.1 drift check on those worlds queued.

Swerve lane25 bag: no tip problem. The rover spins in place at the ramp foot, chasing plan headings that flip ~180 deg between replans (the heading plan ignored the rover's current yaw). Fixed with a start-heading anchor, tested, swerve run sw7a queued.
v2 candidate (ackf) 33/33 on slopes, crater_field, marsyard (v1.1 31/33, rerun today also 31/33). lane25_top 3/3 for the first time, roll 7 to 10 deg. 0 unsafe.
Swerve v7 with the tip margin: 0/9 on its three failing goals (was 1/9), regression 5/6. No gain, rerun on the crest-fix build queued.
Benchmark hung on exit for 42 min after its last run (second time). Killed, and teardown is now capped at 30 s with a forced exit.
v1.1 with the tip margin: 31/33, identical goal for goal to v1.1. The margin is free for v1.1 and helps the heading planner.

Ramp-crest bug: at the crest the camera sees sky, its empty point cloud had a blank frame, which blocked the mapper's TF wait and starved lidar scans. Map went stale, goal aborted 1.6 m short. Fixed (6516aeb).
lane25 cause: the heading mask allowed headings up to the 16.1 deg tip limit, but the monitor aborts at 13.2 deg. Added mask_tip_margin. Heading planner slopes 10/15 to 13/15.
Heading planner over 6 worlds 49/57, equal to v1.1, better on rock_field, urc_mix, bars (21/24 vs 18/24). Swerve v7 full run 36/57, v6 was 35/57.
